title: flt.bpf24~
description: `flt.bpf24~` is a four-pole Butterworth band-pass filter that passes frequencies within a band around a center frequency. Its center frequency can be set in hertz (20–20000 Hz), and its Q factor is defined as center frequency divided by bandwidth; these can be supplied through the second and third inlets or via `@freq` and `@q`.
